translations.web: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
translations.bsb: Whoever curses his father or mother, his lamp will be extinguished in deepest darkness.
translations.kjv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
